neighbours.label: ' by' of means or principle ('lead by example', 'justification by faith', 'government by one person'), not the passive agent 'by'
fire: Good managers lead by example rather than by orders.
In that church, salvation comes by grace alone.
The island was ruled by decree for most of the century.
Decisions in the council are made by consensus.
Many monks believed in living by the rule of silence.
The old king took the throne by force.
Some families still settle disputes by custom rather than law.
Our club chooses its leaders by lot each year.
quiet: The novel was written by a retired nurse from Ohio.
The bridge was designed by a young engineer.
We sat by the river and ate our lunch.
The letter was signed by both of the witnesses.
Her house is by the old railway station.
The song was sung by a choir of children.
The fire was started by a lightning strike.
The painting was bought by a private collector.
